rule: every record in every table shares one createdTime date (2026-08-27)
note: the whole base is one bulk import, so createdTime cannot separate bulk from organic records and issue rates cannot be compared across them

rule: application submitted after the opening's target close date
note: Target Close is a target, not a hard close - weak signal
zero bonus/experience is plausible business data

rule: source label names a specific product, not a channel class
direction: moves share between 'Job Board' and other
note: LinkedIn is arguably a job board; grouping choice moves C1 by ~11 pts
zero bonus/experience is plausible business data

rule: application has a referrer link but the candidate's Source says another channel
direction: misattributes referral hires to job boards
note: two channel signals disagree on 24 of 27 referred applications; 17 of those are labelled 'Job Board'. C1 is 26.9% by Source but 11.5% by Referred By.
zero bonus/experience is plausible business data

rule: hiring manager sits outside the opening's department
note: a shared/matrixed HM is normal in a small org

rule: job not marked Filled but has hired applications
note: a multi-headcount req stays Open after one hire - normal

rule: hired although every interview recommendation was negative
direction: none directly; signals a broken decision trail
note: no check family compares the hire decision to the interview verdicts

rule: offer outside the requisition's salary band
note: no check family compares an offer to its own req's band

rule: same candidate applied to the same opening more than once
note: could be a genuine re-application in a later season

rule: candidate with more than one accepted offer
note: a revised offer to the same person for the same req is normal business behaviour; two different reqs would be a real conflict

rule: job marked Filled but hire count != headcount
out of order: Proposed Start Date before Decision On
out of order: Applied On before Opened On

note: EXPECTED: a future start/close date is normal business data
Decision On absent = genuinely undecided offer
